title: Final bid
style: cinematic horror film still, buzzing fluorescent-lit storage unit corridors and a cramped city apartment at night, an eerily detailed handmade dollhouse, dust in the air, sickly green and warm tungsten tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Gina puts Lot 47 back up for auction. Wait until you see who bids. 🔨

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Gina learned every buyer of Lot 47 sold it within a week, and the figure in the window was waiting for someone.
scenes.image: faceless wooden figure pressed to a tiny dollhouse window at night

scenes.narration: She doesn't answer the door. The bell rings until dawn. Then it stops.
scenes.image: woman sitting on her apartment floor against a wall at dawn, exhausted, facing the front door

scenes.narration: She hauls the dollhouse back to the yard and covers it with the tarp. Put it back up, she tells the auctioneer. Start it at a dollar. I don't care.
scenes.image: woman pushing a tarp-covered dollhouse on a hand truck down a fluorescent-lit storage corridor

scenes.narration: Saturday. The same row. The same flickering light. The regulars stare at their shoes. Nobody bids.
scenes.image: crowd of resellers in a storage corridor all looking down, a covered object in an open unit

scenes.narration: Then, from the back, a hand rises. Forty dollars.
scenes.image: a pale long-fingered hand raised above a crowd in a dim storage corridor

scenes.narration: The crowd parts. A tall man in a long grey coat walks forward. Each step creaks, like old wood settling.
scenes.image: tall thin figure in a long grey coat walking slowly through a parting crowd in a fluorescent corridor

scenes.narration: Where his face should be, there's only smooth, pale grain. Polished. Carved.
scenes.image: close-up of a tall figure's blank wooden faceless head under a hood of shadow, fluorescent light on the grain

scenes.narration: Gina lifts the corner of the tarp. The tiny figure is gone from the dollhouse.
scenes.image: woman lifting a dusty tarp to reveal an empty miniature room inside a dollhouse

scenes.narration: Sold, the auctioneer whispers. The grey man takes the key. Then he turns his blank face to Gina and speaks, in a voice like a floorboard. Thank you. I'll need the address.
scenes.image: faceless figure in a grey coat holding a small brass key, facing a terrified woman in a storage corridor

scenes.narration: He didn't buy the dollhouse. He bought the home it was a model of. Tomorrow night: a ferry that always arrives with one more passenger than it left with.
scenes.image: old car ferry gliding through thick fog on black water at night, deck lights glowing
